title: Support controlling the contrast on DDC-supported monitors
line: The Brightness and Color applet now shows a Contrast slider under the brightness of monitors controlled over DDC/CI.
explanation: Powerdevil only ever read and wrote the brightness feature (VCP 0x10) of DDC/CI monitors, so there was no way to change their contrast from Plasma. Since brightness moved to KWin, the applet's displays are KWin outputs and the DDC/CI monitors are only handed to KWin as brightness devices, which is why the open MR !506 (written for the old layout, and picking the first DDC display for every screen) no longer fits. The change reads and writes contrast (VCP 0x12) in the DDC/CI backend, sharing the write code with brightness and throttling writes like brightness does, and exposes it per screen over D-Bus (Contrast, MaxContrast, SetContrast, ContrastChanged), matching each KWin output to its monitor by EDID the same way KWin does, and only while KWin uses DDC/CI for that output. The applet shows a Contrast slider under that screen's brightness slider, without repeating its name or icon.

commits.message:
brightness: add contrast control for DDC/CI monitors

DDC/CI monitors nearly always support changing their contrast as well,
but only their brightness could be set from Plasma. Read and write the
contrast (VCP 0x12) too, and show a slider below the brightness one.

BUG: 484397

media.caption: Master: a DDC/CI monitor that supports contrast only gets a Brightness slider.
With the fix: a Contrast slider sits under the monitor's brightness, showing the monitor's current 50%.
Dragging the Contrast slider from 30% to 80%, then three Left key presses: the monitor receives 31, 48, 65, 80, then 79, 78, 77 (at most one write every 500 ms); brightness is not touched.
Two screens: only the DDC/CI monitor gets a Contrast slider; keyboard navigation goes brightness, contrast, then the next screen.
Turning "Use DDC/CI" off for the monitor in display settings hides the Contrast slider at once, turning it back on shows it again.
